title: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
overview: The Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) course provides foundational knowledge and skills required to manage and operate small to medium-sized networks. It covers a wide range of networking topics, including network fundamentals, IP connectivity, network access, security, and automation. This course prepares participants for the CCNA (200-301) certification exam.
audience: Individuals seeking to start a career in networking.
Students and learners aiming for foundational networking knowledge and Cisco certification.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: In-depth explanations of Cisco networking concepts and technologies.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for configuring and troubleshooting Cisco network devices.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to apply networking knowledge and skills.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore network challenges and best practices.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Network fundamentals and Cisco device configuration
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of Cisco networking technologies and principles.
To develop practical skills in configuring and troubleshooting Cisco network devices.
To prepare participants for the Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification exam.
To familiarize participants with real-world networking scenarios and solutions.

items.text: Understanding Network Basics (OSI Model, TCP/IP Model)
Identifying Network Devices and Their Functions (Routers, Switches, Hubs)
Understanding Network Topologies and Architectures
Exploring IP Addressing and Subnetting
Configuring and Verifying IPv4 and IPv6 Addressing
Implementing Static and Dynamic Routing Protocols (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP)
Troubleshooting IP Connectivity Issues
Understanding and Configuring NAT (Network Address Translation)
Configuring and Managing VLANs (Virtual LANs) and Trunking
Implementing Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) and EtherChannel
Configuring Access Control Lists (ACLs) and Port Security
Implementing Wireless LAN (WLAN) Access and Security
Configuring DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) and DNS (Domain Name System)
Implementing Network Time Protocol (NTP)
Understanding and Configuring QoS (Quality of Service)
Managing and Troubleshooting IP Services
Implementing Network Security Best Practices
Configuring and Managing Security Features (Firewall, VPN)
Understanding and Preventing Network Attacks (Denial of Service, Man-in-the-Middle)
Securing Network Devices and Access
Understanding Network Automation Concepts and Benefits
Implementing Cisco DNA (Digital Network Architecture)
Using Cisco APIs and Network Programmability Tools
Exploring Network Automation with Python and Ansible
